senses.definition: head of a family that returned with Zerubbabel Ne 7:15 (= בַּני ‖ Ezr 2:10 & perhaps Ezr 10:34 cf. SmListen 14; but BeRy proposes here בִּגְוַי).

a Levite of Ezra’s time Ezr 8:33 Ne 10:10 (prob. = בָּנִי 8:7, בֻּנִּי 9:4) 12:8 cf. 3:24 (בַּוַי, textual error v 18) v. BeRy; also Ezr 2:40 = Ne 7:43 לִבְנֵי read perhaps לְבִנֻּי cf. SmListen 16 but BeRy otherwise; cf. further GrGesch. ii, 2, 389.
